Tests replay dispatcher block, transaction, and scheduling behavior.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the `fd_rdisp` transaction dispatcher. It builds transaction and block cases, inserts them into a dispatcher, and checks that `fd_rdisp_add_block`, `fd_rdisp_add_txn`, `fd_rdisp_get_next_ready`, `fd_rdisp_complete_txn`, `fd_rdisp_remove_block`, `fd_rdisp_promote_block`, `fd_rdisp_demote_block`, and `fd_rdisp_abandon_block` work as expected. The code uses helper functions such as [`add_txn`](<#add_txn>) and [`add_txn2`](<#add_txn2>) to create transactions with different account access patterns, including writable and readonly accounts, signer and nonsigner accounts, and address table accounts.

The file also contains broader stress tests. The [`test_mainnet`](<#test_mainnet>) function can read a block file and replay transactions through the dispatcher while it checks execution order and account version results. The [`random_test`](<#random_test>) function builds random dependency graphs across several lanes and verifies that the dispatcher returns ready transactions in the correct order and respects block boundaries. The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up the RNG, runs the fixed tests, runs the random tests, and ends with `pass` when all checks succeed.
